description: DB-backed integration: migrated schema creates a catalog-backed product and service with authoritative description snapshots and rejects a cross-tenant service id.
Behavioral draft test: cached and fallback picker paths retain distinct name, catalog description, and editable line description; null/custom/discount cases remain clean.
DB-backed lifecycle test: line-description, quantity, and price edits preserve the snapshot while a catalog-selection change recaptures all catalog identity fields.
Lifecycle integration: duplicate, revision, save-as-template, and create-from-template preserve the original snapshot after catalog edit or deletion.
Adapter and binding-catalog test: all three quote item fields resolve in ordinary and grouped collections without undefined fallbacks.
AST compatibility test: legacy single-value columns and new stacked-line columns both validate and round-trip through workspace import/export.
Renderer parity test: stacked name and long/multiline catalog description render in order with independent styles and missing lines collapse in client and server renderers.
Standard-template test: ordinary, recurring, one-time, grouped, and location-grouped quote tables use the stacked preset while custom saved ASTs remain unchanged.
Regression test: quote totals, discounts, taxes, ordering, and conversion outputs are identical before and after adding catalog-description snapshots.

Live smoke: select representative product and service, edit line description, save/reopen layout, and capture preview plus exported PDF showing name above catalog description with long-text pagination.
